The '''''Carida''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], it was the target of an [[Attack on the Carida|attack]] by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Laranna Fain]] defended the ship but was wounded in the process. She was healed by the Sith Lord [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]] posing as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], but was also infected with the [[Dark Plague]]. She was [[Mission to the Carida|rescued]] by a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In game, the ship is described as a standard Republic patrol vessel, but is depicted as an [[Ajuur-class heavy cruiser]]. According to [[Charles Boyd]], the ship was probably intended to be a [[Thranta-class corvette]] by the original developers.<ref>{{Twitter|Charles_Boyd|status/1183156309534879749|[[Charles Boyd]]|nobackup=1}}</ref>
